proof_attempt_summary: Discovery discharged the proposed benchmark profile min{1/5,n^(-1/2)+r n^(-2/7)}, full-parent coverage, original-record converse and constant-order simultaneous adaptation; the mathematical panel passed. The normalized delivered novelty was incremental (raw subfield), below field, and independent terminal audits found no bounded same-topic tier-material repair. tldr:
For the certified benchmark with known uniform scalar design and protocol-certified \(m_{0,P}(x)=1/2\), the full-parent honest expected-length profile is proved:
\(\ell_n(r)=\min\{1/5,n^{-1/2}+r n^{-2/7}\}\).
One explicit radius-blind confidence rule, computed from the original records, has coverage at least \(0.90\) over the entire benchmark parent at every finite \(n\), and attains this profile simultaneously at every heterogeneity radius. The unsaturated terms cross at \(r_c(n)=n^{-3/14}\); no logarithm is essential. The optimal simultaneous adaptation ratio has constant order. Unknown rough observational uptake and the unknown Lipschitz effect remain statistical nuisances. The result supplies a reproducible methods-validation benchmark for uncertainty near homogeneous effects. Its parent \(\mathcal M\) is a strict benchmark subclass of Kennedy's consistency/exchangeability domain, with fixed overlap and smoothness restrictions; the upper profile is not asserted over that full published domain. The clinical PCI and liver-graft examples motivate the uptake-calibrated target and lie outside this theorem's application domain.
gap: Regular fixed-odds and calibrated-composite inference does not evaluate this finite-parent-honest radius-length profile and simultaneous adaptation criterion. The gap includes exact homogeneity and statistically close heterogeneous alternatives in a certified benchmark with rough unknown uptake.
fill: Determine the benchmark radius profile and optimal simultaneous adaptation ratio through observable centering, finite block and tuning inputs, separate pure and mixed corrections, fixed-size marked pair/triple covariance certificates and original-record testing. The profile \(\min\{1/5,n^{-1/2}+r n^{-2/7}\}\), crossover \(r\asymp n^{-3/14}\), root-sample boundary and constant-order adaptation are conjectural Stage-0 targets. An attaining confidence rule would provide a reproducible criterion for validating honest procedures across the benchmark sensitivity coordinate.
